title: Anti IP logger
features:
I created this anti ip logger, what it does is, Blocks IP Loggers: It scans all internet requests and instantly blocks known IP-tracking websites (like Grabify or IPify).

Stops Data Theft: It prevents malicious scripts from using Discord webhooks to steal your private info or game items.
Scans New Code: It intercepts and checks any newly loaded scripts for dangerous keywords before they can run.
Fakes Data: If an IP address is exposed, it automatically replaces it with a fake address
Cleans Hidden Text: It decodes and cleans up heavily disguised or hidden code to find malicious threats that are trying to hide.
Locks Down Game Controls: It overrides core game functions so that unauthorized scripts cannot bypass its security filters.
And best of all, it’s completely open source. No obfuscation.
